instruction: Fix `slugify` so consecutive spaces collapse into a single dash and leading/trailing whitespace is removed.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils.py b/textutils.py
--- a/textutils.py
+++ b/textutils.py
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@
 
 def slugify(s):
     """Lowercase ``s`` and replace runs of whitespace with a single dash."""
-    return s.lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    return "-".join(s.lower().split())
